description: Routes a Security Centre concern to its one next room. Deterministic. Concerns: "digital-life" (Tighten my digital life, including if I do not hold bitcoin yet); "holding-unsure" (I hold bitcoin and I am not sure it is safe); "family-recovery" (I want my family to be able to recover it). Something wrong right now is not a concern: send the person straight to https://thebitcoinadviser.com/bitcoin-emergency-kit, which every result also returns as incident.
name: choose_security_path
title: Choose a Security Centre path
